title: GRAVEL V3 Disc Carbon Road Frame Set – T900, 700C, Endurance & Gravel Racing
notes: Official frameset page identifies the Gravel V3 Disc T900 frame and states maximum tire clearance of 700×40C (page lines 318–337, including line 335). It is a frame/platform claim.
